messages.subject: Project Willow - Standstill Agreement executed
messages.plaintextBody:
Gareth, Fiona,

Please find attached the Standstill and Forbearance Agreement, executed by the Company today. The £120,000 standstill fee will be settled by debit to the Company's account as agreed. We'll commence the IBR with Marlow on the agreed scope and provide the first 13-week cash flow this Friday.

We look forward to working towards a consensual amendment by 31 May.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner, Restructuring & Finance
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
